from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # Locate the regular separator lattice and reduce each rectangle to a pixel.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The cells between lattice dividers are the repeated large regions.
    # Separator boundaries are detected by dominant uniform rows/columns.
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][1] >= w - 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][1] >= h - 1]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            # Matching special corner marks set the output pixel; otherwise use fill.
            special = [v for v in corners if v != fill]
            line.append(special[0] if special and len(set(special)) == 1 and len(special) == 4 else fill)
        out.append(line)
    return out
